description: The bar chart displays the ratio percentages for three large language models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three distinct categories: 'Movies', 'Songs', and 'Basketball'. The horizontal X-axis lists these categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical Y-axis represents the ratio in percentage, scaled linearly from 50% to 90% with tick marks at 10% intervals. For each category, three grouped bars are shown, colored blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT, as indicated by the legend at the top center. In the 'Movies' category, the blue bar for Llama3 reaches approximately 95%, the red bar for Qwen2 reaches approximately 92%, and the yellow bar for ChatGPT reaches approximately 73%. In the 'Songs' category, the blue bar for Llama3 reaches approximately 85%, the red bar for Qwen2 reaches approximately 75%, and the yellow bar for ChatGPT reaches approximately 63%. In the 'Basketball' category, the yellow bar for ChatGPT reaches approximately 70%, the blue bar for Llama3 reaches approximately 65%, and the red bar for Qwen2 reaches approximately 60%. The bars are not sorted by height or any other criterion; they are presented in the order of the categories on the X-axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and height.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the ratio percentages of three models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three categories: 'Movies', 'Songs', and 'Basketball'. The X-axis contains the categories labeled as Movies, Songs, and Basketball, while the Y-axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with tick intervals of 10%. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 consistently exceeded ChatGPT, with Llama3 reaching approximately 95% and Qwen2 slightly below at 92%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 demonstrated a significant decline compared to Llama3, with Qwen2 at approximately 75% and Llama3 at 90%. In the Basketball category, ChatGPT showed the highest ratio at approximately 70%, followed by Llama3 at 65% and Qwen2 at 60%. The legend at the top center identifies the models corresponding to each bar color: blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT.
